title: Benchmarking Vision, Language, & Action Models in Procedurally Generated, Open-Ended Action Environments

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the frequency distribution of models' predicted discrete actions against ground truth action distributions using macro/micro recall metrics and union confusion matrices to identify disproportionate model preferences or defaults (e.g., collapsing predictions to 'Do Nothing' or 'RIGHT' actions) in out-of-distribution environments.
